Somewhere in Africa, a power deal is signed in front of the cameras.

Today we sign for one hundred megawatts of power for our people!

We are ready to build, Minister.

Everyone applauds. But who in this room will carry the risk?

and most developers had put money down.
They still stopped where many power MoUs stop: when a signed commitment must become a financeable one.
